description: This class provides static methods to detect SOCKS4 and SOCKS5 protocol messages within a ByteBuf, used for proxy detection in a Netty-based server.

classes.name: SocksDetector
classes.description: Utility class for detecting SOCKS4 and SOCKS5 protocol messages within ByteBuf streams.

methods.name: isSocks4
methods.description: Detects if the given ByteBuf contains a SOCKS4 message.

methods.name: consumeFields
methods.description: Consumes and validates SOCKS4 fields from ByteBuf.

methods.name: consumeUsername
methods.description: Consumes the username field in SOCKS4 protocol.

methods.name: consumeHostname
methods.description: Consumes the hostname field in SOCKS4 protocol.

methods.name: isSocks5
methods.description: Detects if the given ByteBuf contains a SOCKS5 message.
